notes.title: IGNISTONE demo version is now available!
notes.notes:
Thank you for reading the news page.
While IGNISTONE is scheduled for release on October 3rd, we are excited to announce the release of the demo version!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978167/175789d265409a038b5012db06167b9803140e33.jpg

In the demo, you'll be able to play through the beginning of the game.
After completing the demo, you'll have the option to check out the content of the full version. 

Please enjoy the world of IGNISTONE!
